system.description: Hands empty, eyes down, pace unhurried. You are not hiding. You are simply not worth watching. Requirements You wield no weapon with a Reach greater than Adjacent, and your worn armor totals Load 1 or less. Effects When an encounter begins, you may roll Guile for Initiative. Compare the roll against the Awareness of each enemy that you are Observed to, with the following effects: Critical SuccessThey are Wrong-Footed to you until the end of your first Opportunity. SuccessThey are Wrong-Footed to your first attack. FailureNothing; they were watching you all along. Critical FailureYou overplayed it. You are Wrong-Footed to them until your next Opportunity. Outside an encounter, a Successful Guile check lets you approach, pass, or linger without being challenged by anyone who would otherwise have wanted to know your business.
